basic_info.description: Perched on an upper floor in one of Russian Hill's most iconic buildings, N.504 at the Redstone building blends timeless architecture with modern flair. Built in 1928 by Henry Clay Smith, The Redstone is known for its classic Mediterranean Revival design and boutique feel. From the moment you arrive, walking past the building's manicured front landscaping and elegant facade enlightens your senses, setting the tone. Gracious in scale and flooded with natural light, the unit is framed by large windows on three sides: east, south, and west, offering a luminous setting with views of San Francisco Bay and the Golden Gate Bridge! Throughout the home, classic finishes and thoughtful upgrades come together in a floor plan that feels both elevated and refined. Comfortable public spaces, a generous bedroom suite, perfectly positioned powder room and abundant closet storage create a sophisticated private retreat. With easy access to the Redstone's penthouse-level clubroom and panoramic rooftop terrace, it's easy to enjoy breathtaking views of the GG Bridge, Alcatraz Bay on a daily basis. Professionally managed and maintained, Residence 504 offers Russian Hill living at its finest, just steps from the renowned shops and restaurants of Polk, Union, and Chestnut Streets!
